title: Operations (metrics dashboards now; the team's P&L systems next)
status: draft pack, 2026-10-02; triage owner named by the team; not yet ruled in the decision log
triage_owner_ruling: the team 2026-10-02: "Make it new theme and the team owner" (decision log, filed by the lead); renamed 'operations' on the team's framing the same day: "focus around two themes - components / atlas as well as operations"
theme_owner_ruling: the team 2026-10-02: "and the team for operations"

evaluation.finding_shape: item id · what's wrong · change wanted · theme or engine

engine_owner_ruling: the team 2026-10-02: "I will remain component owner of the triage component for now"

adapter.read: platform/data/metrics/index.json and each run's data.json (performance, inventory, routes), written by the mini's daily refresh; no warehouse access
detector_kinds: patterns over time (positive or negative: order value, returns on spend, the floor without Meta spend, weekday rhythm)
adapter.still_true: the next refresh recomputes every signal; a signal that no longer fires closes itself
adapter.write_back_note: none: signals are derived, the dashboards are not edited
adapter.reopen: automatic: a signal that fires again comes back on the next run

summary.standard: SCHEMA §5 (eight parts), new-workflow-design/builds/atlas/flows/SCHEMA.md, plus money at stake and what the data shows
where: inside each signal and each action group (generated by the detector, tools/metrics_insights.py)

at_creation.rule: every item, action group or issue this theme's triage creates carries all eight parts when it is created; never backfilled
at_creation.ruled: the team, 2026-10-02, received 06:43Z by date -u: "also starting from now make it a rule that anything issues that come from this triage process should geneate with the 8 step summary from the start"

summary.fix_means: the response: what to do, whether a fix, a follow-up on a positive signal, or another move. Key kept as `fix` for compatibility; shown as Response (the team, 2026-10-02)

cause_classes_note: set by the detector that fires; a data-health cause holds the movement signals it would distort

rules.name: detector per brand
rules.group_by: detector × brand (data health, movement, sell-out, patterns), data health first

grouping.why: a signal's decider is the brand's owner for that kind of question (data, ads, stock), so one action per detector per brand reaches one decider

tiers.P1: ≥ $2,000, or data health that holds other signals

priority.live_use_for_p0: money at stake replaces live-use evidence: a signal's dollars are its evidence
priority.severity_source: money at stake per month, computed by the detector

age.from: the first run a signal fired (needs the log; not tracked yet)

owners.source: the metrics component (the team); supply pipeline (the team, her 2026-09-15 ruling); ad spend per brand (not on record)

deciders.spend: the brand's ads owner (not on record; the team or the team to name)

walls: a machine delete or external send
media over the size limit in git
brands/ read-only to machines this phase

lane_conditions.status: the team is the triage owner and owns the data and supply
now: fix a data source or refresh in components/metrics
draft a purchase or expedite (placing it is a person's act)
never: send to a supplier or customer

doer_tags.now: the triage owner can do it alone, today, within the lane conditions
doer_tags.after: the triage owner can do it once a ruling lands (the action's own, or the pending 'apply a ruled default, owner told' ruling)
doer_tags.draft: the triage owner prepares it; the owner lands it (owner's work in flight, a live path, or large)
doer_tags.owner: only the owner can do it (a design call, knowledge or an act only they have)

context_hook.note: signals are about the business, not a code folder; the decision log, read by brand, is the right channel

routes.makers: detector or refresh fixes as cards via the lead
routes.glm: not for signal readings (summaries stay on Claude, TI-24 (red-test summaries GLM) evaluation)

open_gaps: no targets: thresholds wait for owners to set them
the ads owner per brand is not on record
signal age needs the log (first-fired date)
per-warehouse stocking is not modelled; stock is summed per product
blocked_by: a stale run blocks its own movement signals; otherwise nothing

related_sources: the team's P&L systems (as they land)
refs.examples: Brand-A shipping cost unbilled → pnl:pnl_brand_a_orders, pnl:shiphero → DOUX-C7 (orders view stack), MET-C11b (freight follows who billed) (found by text match; to confirm)
